text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Aah! A pimple right by my mouth...! How 
could this happen...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No... wait, could it actually be from 
yesterday's mega-portion ramen 
challenge...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I treated this as a trial and cleaned my 
plate, but... I didn't think there'd be 
such a backlash...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Maintaining an appearance befitting a 
Saint is part of my duties. I must take 
immediate countermeasures...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire found herself troubled by skin 
breakouts...
